elements.element: Customer owns deliverables/work product created for it
elements.evidence: "All results of the Support Services and any other materials prepared by TrueLink specifically for Client under this Agreement shall be the sole property of Client"

elements.element: Vendor assigns such rights to Customer
elements.evidence: "TrueLink hereby assigns to Client all right, title and interest therein"
"TrueLink retains all of its ownership and license rights in the Interface" (Section 2(d), untouched)

elements.element: Perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to Vendor IP embedded in deliverables
elements.evidence: "To the extent any TrueLink Intellectual Property is embedded in such results or materials, TrueLink grants Client a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free license"

elements.element: Customer retains all rights in Customer Data
elements.evidence: "Client retains all right, title and interest in and to the Client Content, Client's Intellectual Property and all data provided by or on behalf of Client or its customers, brokers or borrowers"
"No jointly owned intellectual property is created under this Agreement."

elements.element: Vendor owns generic tools and know-how
elements.evidence: No reference to generic tools or know-how anywhere in the redline; only "ownership and license rights in the Interface"

elements.element: Customer licence to deliverables is perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free
elements.evidence: Licence granted is only "perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free" and covers embedded TrueLink IP, not a worldwide deliverables licence

elements.element: Licence permits use, modification and sublicensing for Customer's business
elements.evidence: Grant text stops at "royalty-free license to such TrueLink Intellectual Property as part of such results or materials" — no use/modify/sublicense verbs

reasons: The inserted paragraph completes every atomic element of the preferred position: Customer ownership of results/materials with an express present assignment, retention of Client Content, IP and borrower/loan data, an embedded-Vendor-IP licence on the three required attributes, and an express no-joint-ownership statement.

Fallback is not satisfied (no generic tools/know-how ownership, no worldwide/modify/sublicense deliverables licence), which is correct and expected since the locked target is preferred and the levels must not be mixed.

Minimality holds: the document had no Customer-side ownership provision, so a concise inserted paragraph is the least intrusive fix; it adds no fallback-only worldwide, modification or sublicensing rights and no broad new exceptions.

Intent is preserved: TrueLink's Interface rights under Section 2(d) and its Section 8(d) Credit Data licence are expressly carved out and remain effective, and no undefined term or dangling mechanic is introduced (Client Content, Client's Intellectual Property and Support Services are existing terms).
Note only for the rationale, not a deviation: the new paragraph is numbered "e" while a later existing paragraph remains labelled "d", a pre-existing numbering artefact in the source text.
